styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent fresh green wellness ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of soft mint background #DFF2E0, clean card white #FFFFFF, leafy green primary #689F38, and one lemon-yellow accent #F5D93F; neutral tone; modern rounded geometric sans-serif with short 「」-wrapped copy; soft rounded-rectangle and circle info labels; thin-line green icon style; clean high-end product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable product scale and placement; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no efficacy or health claims.

provenance.notes: 源长图《泡腾片.JPG》按 7 片 800x1200 切片逐片提炼。已剥离：源标签文字（HEALTHY BODY / BETTER LIFE 等）、全部功效声称文案（免疫/感冒/美白/衰老/病菌等均转 {selling_point}/{callout} 槽位）、末片会员二维码与价格促销贴（收口屏改为行动按钮与福利钩子）。品类判定：图为维C泡腾片固体冲剂，与源文件夹「保健」一致，归为医药保健/营养补充；库内已有胶囊与蛋白粉款，本款以泡腾片剂型+鲜果风味日历结构作区分。原长图中的绿色图片区已转写为柑橘水果与工艺实拍面板。
